description: We are people interested in physics and engineering, specially in aplications of physical principles to space exploration and further investigation.
summary: We developed a Super Intelligence model meant to predict the formation of both hot and cool flames in spacecrafts by analizing data of NASA's previous experiments related to combustion in spacecrafts. It's purpose is to anticipate the start of a sudden fire. It addresses the challenge by relating the power of training a Super Intelligence model with the boost of space investigation and exploration. The importance consists of a better understanding of these phenomena to improve the system used today for prevention and research.
details: FlameTwin is a data analysis program that by the random forest algorithm draws conclusions about hot ignition according to the data provided by the CFI experiments in the NASA PSI repositories. The program analyses data and allows making predictions about different outcomes of ignition probability, it can also be trained with users’ experimental data. Thanks to it, the user can analyze data faster and more precisely, also permiting to conclude faster. To develop the program we made use of OpenAI ChatGPT as the only external Super Intelligence tool; for the coding language, we used Python and Streamlit as the software. We thought of designing this tool to allow users to train a model using their own experimental data. We aimed to conduct research on both cold and hot combustion in NASA exploration missions and, eventually, use the tool for fire prevention in these same missions.
